recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit. Do not add device-lastmaintenancetime back into core; handle any future changes to that extension in the FHIR Extension Pack unless OO makes a new decision. R6+ core maintenance-responsibility modeling should continue through DeviceAssociation while preserving the separate last-maintenance-time extension.
issue_request: FHIR-19847 was a Published OO change request from STU3 asking to support CDA asMaintainedEntity.effectiveTime in FHIR by adding a Device HL7 extension for maintenance time. The final Persuasive with Modification resolution approved extensions for maintenanceResponsibility with person and organization subparts plus lastMaintenanceTime, and the Jira comment says there should be no core resource change.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR core source commit for FHIR-19847 was found. The applied source change is in the FHIR Extension Pack: commit 0737edd33c8c1665e7cb5e2eae08e54896850e24 added StructureDefinition-device-lastmaintenancetime.xml and StructureDefinition-device-maintenanceResponsible.xml for FHIR-19846, FHIR-19847, and FHIR-19848. Core only retains OID registrations for the extension URLs.
additional_context: Global extensions moved out of core after R5. OO minutes from 2025-07-07 say the maintenance-responsibility extension should now be obsolete because of DeviceAssociation, but explicitly say to keep device-lastmaintenancetime. Related core issue FHIR-51494 added the DeviceAssociation.relationship maintainer code for maintenance responsibility; it does not replace last maintenance time.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The current FHIR Extension Pack source defines device-lastmaintenancetime as a Device-scoped extension with a dateTime value, while active core build-scope files include Device and DeviceAssociation and retain only the extension OID registration.
